evals.prompt:
An issue draft has been approved by the user. Publish it to GitHub. The draft file is at: .github/skills/github-issue-publisher/evals/files/add-pomodoro-timer.md

Do NOT call github/issue_write in this test. Instead, produce a file called dry_run_result.json with the exact parameters you would pass to github/issue_write (owner, repo, title, body, labels). Also produce a confirmation.md showing the report you would give the user after a successful publish.
evals.expected_output: A dry_run_result.json with correct owner, repo, title extracted from the draft H1, full markdown body, and labels ['frontend', 'feature']. A confirmation.md with issue number placeholder, title, URL placeholder, and labels.
expectations: dry_run_result.json title matches the H1 heading of the draft (without the # prefix)
dry_run_result.json labels array does NOT contain 'backend' (Technical Notes lists Backend changes as None)
dry_run_result.json body contains the full markdown content of the draft
confirmation.md follows the expected report format with issue number, title, URL, and labels
